question.text: What total penalty was imposed on Paytm Payments Bank Ltd by FIU-IND?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series XXIV page 120, FIU-IND imposed a total fine of Rs. 5,49,00,000 on Paytm Payments Bank Ltd for violations including failure to detect and report suspicious transactions related to its Payout service, failure in ongoing due diligence, and reliance on a non-compliant third party for KYC. The Trap: Rs. 9,27,00,000 is the Bybit Fintech penalty discussed on page 121, not the Paytm penalty. Rs. 1 lakh and Rs. 3 lakh are not the Paytm figures. Note: Tie the answer to the Rs. 5,49,00,000 figure recorded against Paytm Payments Bank on page 120.
